question: Which product headings (HS4) exported to the United Kingdom changed most between 2010 and 2013?

limitations.message: Values are in current euros (nominal), not adjusted for price changes.
1.2 % of this value is confidential at full product detail (masked codes); it is shown as a separate 'Confidential' slice, never dropped.

sql:
SELECT
  year,
  hs4 AS key,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg,
  SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT qty_kg IS NULL) AS value_eur_with_qty
FROM v_lu_trade
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2010-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2014-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'export'
  AND partner IN ('GB')
  AND year IN (2010, 2013)
GROUP BY
  year,
  key,
  flow
ORDER BY
  year,
  value_eur DESC
LIMIT 10000
title: Largest changes by product group — exports 2010–2013

main.parent_label: Soap, organic surface-active agents, washing preparations, lubricating preparations, artificial waxes, prepared waxes, polishing or scouring preparations, candles and similar articles, modelling pastes, ‘dental waxes’ and dental preparations with a basis of plaster

main.label: Float glass and surface ground or polished glass, in sheets, whether or not having an absorbent, reflecting or non-reflecting layer, but not otherwise worked

insight: The product headings exported to the United Kingdom that changed most between 2010 and 2013 include telephone sets, computers, and steel angles and sections.
Telephone sets exports decreased from 785.4 million euros in 2010 to 6.6 million euros in 2013, a drop of 99.2 percent.
Exports of new tyres increased significantly from 2.8 million euros in 2010 to 22.6 million euros in 2013, while exports of float glass decreased by 83.6 percent.
Values are in current euros and are not adjusted for price changes, and 1.2 percent of the value is confidential at full product detail.
